reasoning_content: So the worker becomes ready when either a job is successfully claimed or the queue is empty. But it fails with `worker:getJob:error` when an RLS error occurs during the `getJob` query. My manual test succeeded in both inserting directly and using `add_job`, so the issue must be in the actual `getJob` query itself. I need to track down what that query looks like in the graphile-worker v0.16.6 source, since it's not showing up in my searches for "SKIP LOCKED" or "claim."

action.command: cd /workspace && D=node_modules/.pnpm/graphile-worker@0.16.6_typescript@6.0.3/node_modules/graphile-worker/dist; grep -rn "getJob" $D/worker.js | head; echo "=== main.js ==="; grep -rn "insert into\|_private" $D/main.js 2>/dev/null | head
